name: Onii-chan ni Amaetagari na Imouto de Gomen ne!
original_name: お兄ちゃんに甘えたがりな妹でゴメンね！
source:
"I love you, onii-chan!"
"Sorry, we can't do this."

Hinata ardently dotes and fawns over her older step-brother Hayato on a daily basis. However, he told her, "Isn't it high time for you to stop this now?". What will happen to her love life now!?

A romantic comedy between a straight-laced older brother and a younger sister with a brother complex!

[Translated from the [url=http://mintwings.web.fc2.com/m14/story.html]Official Website[/url].]
translation:
“我喜欢你，哥哥！”
“抱歉，不行。”

日向每天都热情地向自己喜欢的义兄隼人撒娇示爱。然而，他却对她说。“你是不是也该停止这样了？”她的恋情究竟会何去何从！？

一本正经的哥哥与兄控妹妹之间的恋爱喜剧！

[译自[url=http://mintwings.web.fc2.com/m14/story.html]官方网站[/url]。]
